ValidationRule.description: Freight - Recovery Information Section is required before closure of a Freight Claims/Feedback request and when either Recovery Solution or Recover Cost is filled in for all Freight cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(OR((RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Freight_Claims'), (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Freight_Feedback')), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), OR(ISBLANK( Freight_Recovery_Cost__c ), ISPICKVAL( Freight_Recovery_Solution__c , ""))), AND((RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Freight_Claims'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Freight_Recovery_Solution__c , "")), ISBLANK( Freight_Recovery_Cost__c )), AND((RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Freight_Claims'), NOT(ISBLANK( Freight_Recovery_Cost__c )),ISPICKVAL( Freight_Recovery_Solution__c , "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill out the Recovery Information section
